title: OPERA SINGING MASTERCLASS 2026 in Bangkok
description:
Following the success of last year's Masterclass with world acclaimed tenor Fabio Armiliato, The Royal Bangkok Symphony Orchestra with The Istituto Italiano di Cultura Bangkok and Belcanto Academy Bangkok are organizing singing Masterclasses in 2026.

• 13 - 20 September 2026 Masterclass 1 - Tenor Fabio Armiliato (teacher) only for male voices participants.
• 9 - 15 November 2026 Masterclass 2 - Soprano Barbara Frittoli (teacher) only for female voices participants.
Everyday from 14,00 - 18,00 with final Concert.

8 students for each Masterclass.
Students fee 30,000 THB
Scholarships will be granted by specific cases which are by a specialized committee chaired by the instructor in special cases. The request of a scholarship must be specified in the application.

APPLICATION:
• Two videos, or more of the applicant singing different arias or songs (Italian repertoire)
• CV complete with picture
• No age restriction

The terms to subject the applications are:
• Fabio Armiliato Masterclass :August 15 - 2026
• Barbara Frittoli Masterclass :October 15 - 2026

For further info and specifics please write directly to: Mr. Camillo Pellegatta - camart530@gmail.com

title: รักลูก Tales & Plays 2026
description:
หมายเหตุ

  1. ผู้ชมทุกท่านต้องมีบัตรเข้าชมการแสดง บัตร 1 ใบต่อผู้ชม 1 ท่าน (บัตรราคาเดียวกันทั้งเด็ก และ ผู้ใหญ่) ใช้ได้เฉพาะวันและรอบแสดงที่กำหนดบนบัตรเท่านั้น
  2. เด็กส่วนสูงไม่เกิน 90 ซม. สามารถเข้าชมฟรี โดยนั่งตักผู้ปกครอง โปรดติดต่อเจ้าหน้าที่ ที่จุดจำหน่ายบัตร(หน้างาน) ก่อนเข้าห้องชมนิทาน
  3. การแสดงนิทาน 1 ชั่วโมง เป็นภาษาไทย
  4. สำหรับเด็กเล็ก อายุต่ำกว่า 2 ปี การเข้าชมการแสดง อาจมีเสียงดังและการใช้เทคนิคพิเศษ ระหว่างการแสดง ที่ทำให้เด็กตกใจ และร้องไห้ได้
  5. บัตรชมนิทานที่ซื้อแล้วไม่สามารถเปลี่ยนรอบและไม่สามารถเปลี่ยนที่นั่งได้
  6. ข้อมูลและคิวอาร์โค้ดบนหน้าบัตรเข้าชมการแสดง ถือเป็นความลับ เพื่อผลประโยชน์ของผู้ถือบัตร จึงไม่ควรเปิดเผยข้อมูลแก่ผู้อื่น
  7. การซื้อบัตรชมนิทานหมายถึงผู้ซื้อยอมรับตามข้อตกลงที่ทางผู้จัดงานกำหนดข้างต้นแล้วทุกประการ
  8. การยกเลิกการสั่งซื้อ คุณสามารถยกเลิกการสั่งซื้อได้ก่อนทำการชำระเงิน บริษัทฯ ขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการยกเลิกคำสั่งซื้อสำหรับรายการที่ได้รับชำระเงินเรียบร้อยแล้ว
  9. การคืนบัตรและการคืนเงิน การสั่งซื้อบัตรที่ทำธุรกรรมครบถ้วนสมบูรณ์แล้ว หมายถึง ท่านได้ชำระค่าสินค้า และค่าบริการแก่ทางบริษัทฯ เรียบร้อยแล้ว ไม่สามารถคืนเงินหรือยกเลิกได้ จะสามารถคืนบัตรการแสดงได้ในกรณีที่การแสดงถูกเลื่อนหรือยกเลิก
  10. การรับบัตรเข้าชมการแสดงนิทาน (ที่หน้างาน)
  • ติดต่อรับบัตรที่เคาน์เตอร์จำหน่ายบัตร ตามวันและเวลาที่เลือกชมการแสดงนิทาน เปิดรับบัตรก่อนรอบการแสดง 1 ชั่วโมง
  • ให้แสดง E-Ticket ที่มี คิวอาร์โค้ดที่ได้รับจากการสั่งซื้อบัตรนิทาน ทาง www.ticketmelon.com เพื่อรับบัตรเข้าชมนิทาน 
  • การดูบัตร E-Ticket ได้ที่อีเมลผู้ซื้อบัตร หรือ ที่หน้าเว็บไซต์ของ www.ticketmelon.com โดย “เข้าสู่ระบบ” ด้วยอีเมลที่ท่านใช้ลงทะเบียนบัญชี Ticketmelon หลังจากนั้นให้ท่านไปที่ มุมขวา และเลือก “บัตรของฉัน” ในส่วนของอีเว้นท์ที่กำลังมา จะมีโปสเตอร์งานที่ท่านซื้อบัตรไว้ปรากฎอยู่ กดที่ปุ่ม “ดูบัตร” เพื่อทำการดูบัตร

“Detective Conan 30th Anniversary TV Series Exhibition”

The “Detective Conan 30th Anniversary TV Series Exhibition” celebrates the 30th anniversary of the legendary anime series Detective Conan, a global fan favorite. Thailand is proud to be the very first country in Southeast Asia to host this prestigious exhibition, following its overwhelming success and massive response in Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea.

This exhibition invites Conan fans to retrace the 30-year journey of the beloved anime through detailed displays and exclusive behind-the-scenes insights. Visitors will explore everything from creative concepts, scene designs, and storyboards to animation production, voice acting, and the iconic soundtracks cherished by fans worldwide.

The event is packed with exciting exhibition zones and highlights, including scale models of iconic locations from the series. Key attractions include the Storyboard Wall, which gathers memorable storyboards from across the 30-year history; the Voice Acting Zone, showcasing the character charms through their iconic voices; and the "SP Gratitude Theater," a special cinema screening exclusive video content dedicated entirely to celebrating this 30th anniversary milestone.

Don't Miss the Highlights!

Get ready for the Collectible Ticket (Random)—a premium, officially licensed, beautifully crafted keepsake from Japan featuring 31 character designs to randomly collect. Fans can test their luck to get their favorite character and cherish a once-in-a-lifetime memory of this 30th anniversary.

Tickets are available in 3 categories:

  • VIP Ticket: 500 THB Includes 1 random Collectible Ticket, an exclusive Detective Conan poster, a Limited Edition Badge, and a magnifying glass.

  • Fan Fan Ticket: 900 THB (Limited Quantity) The ultimate premium package for die-hard fans, fully loaded with 30th-anniversary collectibles. This includes 1 random Collectible Ticket, a 30th Anniversary Acrylic Stand, an exclusive Detective Conan poster, a Limited Edition Badge, a magnifying glass, and a highly exclusive "1 Premium Rose" (limited to only 1,000 sets worldwide).

Merchandise Zones

The event features two types of merchandise areas:

  1. Free Area Pop-up Shop: Open to the general public; no admission ticket required.

  2. Exclusive Limited Merchandise Zone: Reserved strictly for exhibition ticket holders only.

title: Show Thực Cảnh Anh Hùng Cờ Lau - Đinh Bộ Lĩnh
description:
Giới thiệu sự kiện:

Show Thực Cảnh “Anh Hùng Cờ Lau – Đinh Bộ Lĩnh” là vở diễn ngoài trời quy mô lớn tái hiện hành trình từ cậu bé chăn trâu phất cờ lau tập trận đến khi lên ngôi Hoàng đế, mở đầu triều đại Đại Cồ Việt — thời kỳ độc lập đầu tiên của dân tộc.

Được trình diễn trên sân khấu thủy đình độc đáo giữa không gian Phố Cổ Hoa Lư, chương trình quy tụ hàng chục nghệ sĩ, diễn viên cùng hệ thống âm thanh — ánh sáng hiện đại, hiệu ứng khói lửa và pháo hoa rực rỡ. Đây là trải nghiệm văn hóa – lịch sử – giải trí đặc sắc, mang đến một đêm “lịch sử sống” giữa lòng Ninh Bình mà du khách không nên bỏ lỡ.

Chi tiết sự kiện:

Chương trình chính:

  • Đại cảnh tái hiện tuổi thơ Đinh Bộ Lĩnh với trò chơi cờ lau tập trận
  • Các trường đoạn lịch sử: dẹp loạn 12 sứ quân, thống nhất đất nước
  • Màn đăng quang Hoàng đế Đinh Tiên Hoàng
  • Biểu diễn nghệ thuật truyền thống kết hợp âm thanh – ánh sáng hiện đại
  • Hiệu ứng sân khấu nước, khói lửa và pháo hoa kết thúc hoành tráng
  • Thời gian biểu diễn định kỳ vào buổi tối các ngày Thứ 5, 6, 7 và Chủ nhật

Khách mời & Ekip thực hiện:

Chương trình được dàn dựng bởi đội ngũ đạo diễn, biên đạo và nghệ sĩ uy tín trong lĩnh vực sân khấu, xiếc và nghệ thuật trình diễn, cùng hơn 30 nghệ sĩ, diễn viên tham gia.

  • Tổng Biên Đạo: Uyên Chi

Cùng hơn 30 nghệ sĩ và diễn viên tạo nên những đại cảnh sống động, tái hiện lịch sử hào hùng của dân tộc.

Trải nghiệm đặc biệt:

  • Không gian Phố Cổ Hoa Lư về đêm với kiến trúc tái hiện kinh đô xưa
  • Khu check-in cổ phục, giáp phục thời Đinh và bối cảnh lịch sử
  • Các gian hàng ẩm thực và đặc sản địa phương
  • Hoạt động tương tác văn hóa, trò chơi dân gian trước giờ diễn

Relive the golden age of jazz with "Swing Era"! Hosted by Jelly Roll Jazz Club, this four-night festival in Bangkok, Thailand (August 20-23, 2026) will transport you t o the heart of the swing scene. Learn from international swing dance legends like Sakarias Larsson, Frida Häggström Gerdt, Hector Artal, Sonia Ortega, Chester Whitmore, Sing Lim, and Lennart Westerlund.

Then, oomph, ah shishkaboompa to a music that was defined by generations! Two live bands each night will keep the dance floor swinging, including Eyal Vilner, Clapstomp Swingin', Brothers Arntzen, Yusu Jazz Band, and the mighty Thailand Jazz Orchestra. title: Timor-Leste (East Timor): ASEAN’s newest member looks forward from a painful past
description:
Last October, Timor-Leste (East Timor) became the newest member of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, taking its place among regional peers 26 years after the end of a brutal occupation by Indonesia.

Following its invasion in 1975, Indonesia largely sealed off the territory. During the occupation, approximately 20-30 percent of the population were killed or died from hunger and illness. Only a handful of passionate and committed foreign journalists made it into East Timor under those conditions. One who did was John Martinkus, who later authored a penetrating account about the conflict titled ‘A Dirty Little War’. Martinkus died in his native Australia last year but is still seen by many in Timor-Leste as a hero.

Martinkus alerted the world to the emerging threat from Indonesian military-supported militias that in 1999 tried to brutalize the Timorese into rejecting independence. Those violent tactics failed but cost many lives and destroyed much of the new nation’s infrastructure.  Almost 30 years later, Timor-Leste enjoys good ties with Indonesia, and is looking to its ASEAN partners and southern neighbour Australia to help grow its economy.

Join us for a reflection on the country’s remarkable journey while honoring the late John Martinkus and other journalists who documented the war in Timor-Leste at a rare screening of Carmela Baranowska’s powerful documentary, ‘Scenes from an Occupation,’ which won the 2000 Rory Peck Award and is the only film to document the last six months of Indonesia’s occupation. There will also be an exhibition of photos by Ian Timberlake, an Agence France-Presse correspondent who was in Timor Leste and knew Martinkus well. 

‍Francisco Tilman Cepeda, Ambassador of Timor-Leste to Thailand, will make opening remarks before the film. 

After the film, there will be a panel of speakers: 

‍Dr Carmela Baranowska, director of ‘Scenes from an Occupation: East Timor 1999’. 

‍Ian Timberlake, AFP correspondent in East Timor in 1999. His photos from the period are being exhibited in conjunction with this panel.

Moderator: Jonathan Head, who covered the 1999 events and is an FCCT board member.

การกลับมารวมตัวกันครั้งยิ่งใหญ่ของคณะชมพูนุช  จากคณะละครนอกตามขนบที่เคยเล่นให้เพื่อนนิสิตหอในฯ จุฬา ได้รับชมเพื่อความบันเทิง  สู่การนำนิทานคลาสสิกเรื่องซินเดอเรลลา มาตีความในรูปแบบของละครนอกร่วมสมัย  ที่จะพาผู้ชมทลายกรอบ ก้าว ‘ออก’ จากความรับรู้เดิมในตำราเรียน

Whether you were there when PINK first came out in 2005, or you discovered this all-time classic in the two decades since, this is a musical experience we can guarantee will become a once-in-a-lifetime memory, without a doubt.

title: DOMi & JD BECK - WHO ASKED? Tour Live in Kuala Lumpur
description:
DOMi & JD BECK : Live in Kuala Lumpur

Some acts you watch. This one you try to keep up with.

French keyboardist Domi Louna and Texan drummer JD Beck, arrived seemingly out of nowhere with a Coltrane cover renamed "Giant Nuts," a 4:20 Madvillain medley, and a livestream jam with Ariana Grande and Thundercat. Their 2022 debut NOT TiGHT, released on Blue Note in partnership with Anderson .Paak's APESHIT, Inc., pulled in Herbie Hancock, Mac DeMarco and Busta Rhymes, plus two GRAMMY nominations including Best New Artist. Then they disappeared.

They're back with WHO ASKED?, their highly anticipated sophomore album. Written almost entirely in isolation over two years, the record expands their sonic universe with lush orchestral arrangements, intricate compositions, and—for the first time—vocals from the duo themselves. The result is a wildly original blend of jazz, electronic, indie, classical, and pop that only DOMi & JD BECK could create.

Two people. Four limbs each. More sound than should be physically possible.
